guidance.sum_inconsistency_in_our_data: Recompute totals from row-level votes and reject record when sum != valid_votes.
guidance.catastrophic_parse_or_truncation: Add strict numeric sanity checks and rerun extraction with stronger prompt/OCR fallback.
guidance.weak_summary_source_low_confidence: Prioritize raw image OCR or manual verification for weak summary rows.
guidance.small_numeric_noise: Apply targeted digit normalization and small-value correction pass.
guidance.medium_digit_parse_error: Use per-cell OCR or candidate-row crops for re-read.
guidance.likely_thousand_block_or_grouping_error: Check Thai separators/grouping, missing leading digits, and comma/space parse.
guidance.partial_row_capture: Detect missing rows and run continuation/page-layout-aware extraction.
guidance.major_structural_mismatch: Likely wrong form/page mapping; verify province/district/form assignment first.
